caption: The drawing depicts a wooden spinning wheel, predominantly colored in shades of brown, suggesting its construction from wood. The spinning wheel consists of a large circular wheel on the left side, supported by a central spindle and several evenly spaced spokes connecting the inner circle to the outer rim. The wheel is attached to a rectangular base with beveled edges, which is supported by three turned legs that angle outward. To the right of the wheel, an arrangement of vertical spindles, rods, and horizontal supports forms the functional spinning mechanism. The structural elements, including the wheel, legs, and upright rods, all share a similar wood grain pattern and color. The entire device is positioned diagonally within a thin, rectangular frame on a light beige background, and there are faint marks and light stains visible on the paper surrounding the drawing. In the lower margin, the words "actual size" are written in faint pencil.
title: Spinning Wheel
